title: Patrol the square
heading: Patrol the square
description: Two sides are written. Add the next two sides so the robot returns to START, facing right. Use the dotted route to work out each move.

scene.label: A robot starts in the upper left corner of a dotted square, facing right. Each side is three tiles long. Its trail shows the instructions it follows.

completions.description: Turn a quarter turn to the right, without moving

feedback.success: Compare the trail with the dotted square. Did the robot return to START facing right? Which pair of instructions repeats?
